caption:
A du'a of Prophet Musa (Moses), peace be upon him: "My Lord, expand for me my breast and ease for me my task."

Surah Taa-Haa (20:25-26). Swipe through for the Arabic, then English, Mandarin, Korean and Japanese renderings.

Sources on the final slide.

sourcing.arabic: Uthmani script (quran-uthmani), api.alquran.cloud. Two independent live fetches this session (2026-11-08) of GET /v1/ayah/20:{25..28}/editions/quran-uthmani,en.sahih,zh.jian,ko.korean,ja.japanese, HTTP 200 each, diffed: byte-identical. Verbatim.
sourcing.english: Saheeh International (en.sahih). Raw: "[Moses] said, \"My Lord, expand for me my breast [with assurance] And ease for me my task". Only the unmatched opening quotation mark before 'My Lord' was dropped (the quotation continues past these ayat). Wording untouched.
sourcing.chinese: Ma Jian (zh.jian). Verbatim, ayat joined with no separator.
sourcing.korean: ko.korean; source metadata lists translator as 'Unknown', credited on-slide as not specified. Raw: "이때 모세가 주여 저를 위해저의 마음을 활짝 열어주소서 그리고 저의 일이 쉽도록 하여 주소서". Spacing-only fix: '위해저의' -> '위해 저의' (missing space). No wording changed.
sourcing.japanese: ja.japanese; source metadata lists translator as 'Unknown', cited as such. Verbatim: "かれは（祈って）言った。「主よ，わたしの胸を広げて下さい。わたしの仕事を容易にして下さい。"
sourcing.verification_note: All renderings from two live api.alquran.cloud fetches this session, diffed identical; none from memory. Ayat 27-28 were deliberately excluded because the Japanese edition's 20:27 contains a corrupted character in the source data. Manual halal compliance check against scripts/data/compliance-policy.json blocklists: clean; typography only, no imagery. Dupcheck: quran:20:25-26 NEW.
